svg.title: Compare Direct Contribution Across Domain Sale Routes
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-domain-route-contribution-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Direct Contribution Across Domain Sale Routes; subtitle: Five independent $10,000 sale examples; bar values are percentages.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: All examples are hypothetical completed sales, not observed market yields. Direct contribution equals sale proceeds less acquisition, renewal, selling, and stated deal-specific costs. Shared overhead, unsold inventory, and holding time are excluded, so these percentages are not annual net margins.; caption: Compare routes only after equalizing sale price and cost definitions. These independent examples do not replace the canonical 15%, 27.5%, and 40% annual net margins.; stages: label: Brandable via marketplace; value: 54% direct contribution; $5,400 retained; numeric value: 54.0; detail: $10,000 proceeds less $3,000 acquisition, $1,500 selling costs, and $100 renewals leaves $5,400; invented-word appeal still requires mark screening.; label: Exact-match via marketplace; value: 44% direct contribution; $4,400 retained; numeric value: 44.0; detail: $10,000 proceeds less $4,000 acquisition, $1,500 selling costs, and $100 renewals leaves $4,400; descriptive wording does not eliminate rights conflicts.; label: Expired-authority via marketplace; value: 30% direct contribution; $3,000 retained; numeric value: 30.0; detail: $10,000 proceeds less $5,000 acquisition, $1,500 selling costs, $100 renewals, and $400 historical-use research leaves $3,000; rankings can disappear.; label: Drop-catch resale via marketplace; value: 37% direct contribution; $3,700 retained; numeric value: 37.0; detail: $10,000 proceeds less $4,500 acquisition including auction fees, $1,500 selling costs, $100 renewals, and $200 diligence leaves $3,700.; label: Outbound upgrade via direct escrow; value: 55% direct contribution; $5,500 retained; numeric value: 55.0; detail: $10,000 proceeds less $3,500 acquisition, $300 assumed settlement costs, $100 renewals, and $600 outreach leaves $5,500; verify actual escrow pricing.

label: Exact-match via marketplace; value: 44% direct contribution; $4,400 retained; numeric value: 44.0; detail: $10,000 proceeds less $4,000 acquisition, $1,500 selling costs, and $100 renewals leaves $4,400; descriptive wording does not eliminate rights conflicts.

label: Expired-authority via marketplace; value: 30% direct contribution; $3,000 retained; numeric value: 30.0; detail: $10,000 proceeds less $5,000 acquisition, $1,500 selling costs, $100 renewals, and $400 historical-use research leaves $3,000; rankings can disappear.

label: Drop-catch resale via marketplace; value: 37% direct contribution; $3,700 retained; numeric value: 37.0; detail: $10,000 proceeds less $4,500 acquisition including auction fees, $1,500 selling costs, $100 renewals, and $200 diligence leaves $3,700.

label: Outbound upgrade via direct escrow; value: 55% direct contribution; $5,500 retained; numeric value: 55.0; detail: $10,000 proceeds less $3,500 acquisition, $300 assumed settlement costs, $100 renewals, and $600 outreach leaves $5,500; verify actual escrow pricing.

text.title: Assumptions: All examples are hypothetical completed sales, not observed market yields. Direct contribution equals sale proceeds less acquisition, renewal, selling, and stated deal-specific costs. Shared overhead, unsold inventory, and holding time are excluded, so these percentages are not annual net margins.
